title: An Analysis of Artificial Intelligence Adoption in NIH-Funded Research
abstract: arXiv:2604.07424v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Understanding the landscape of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) adoption across the National Institutes of Health (NIH) portfolio is critical for research funding strategy, institutional planning, and health policy. The advent of large language models (LLMs) has fundamentally transformed research landscape analysis, enabling researchers to perform large-scale semantic extraction from thousands of unstructured research documents. In this paper, we illustrate a human-in-the-loop research methodology for LLMs to automatically classify and summarize research descriptions at scale. Using our methodology, we present a comprehensive analysis of 58,746 NIH-funded biomedical research projects from 2025. We show that: (1) AI constitutes 15.9% of the NIH portfolio with a 13.4% funding premium, concentrated in discovery, prediction, and data integration across disease domains; (2) a critical research-to-deployment gap exist

translated_title: 美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）资助研究中人工智能应用的分析
translated_abstract: 了解人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）在美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）资助项目组合中的应用格局，对于研究资助战略、机构规划和健康政策至关重要。大语言模型（LLM）的出现从根本上改变了研究格局分析，使研究人员能够从数千份非结构化研究文档中进行大规模语义提取。在本文中，我们展示了一种基于人在回路（human-in-the-loop）的LLM研究方法，用于大规模自动分类和总结研究描述。利用该方法，我们对2025年58,746个NIH资助的生物医学研究项目进行了全面分析。我们表明：(1) AI占NIH资助组合的15.9%，并享有13.4%的资助溢价，集中于各疾病领域的发现、预测和数据整合；(2) 存在关键的从研究到部署的差距……
tldr: 本文提出一种人在回路的LLM研究方法，对58,746个NIH资助的生物医学项目进行分析，发现AI项目占NIH资助组合的15.9%并享有13.4%的资助溢价，但存在从研究到部署的关键差距。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a human-in-the-loop LLM methodology to analyze 58,746 NIH-funded biomedical projects, finding that AI constitutes 15.9% of the NIH portfolio with a 13.4% funding premium, while a critical research-to-deployment gap exists.
